## What it is

A plain oblong tray, sized directly in millimetres (209.5 x 41.5mm by default), with
rounded outside corners (`outer_round`). Flat bed-contact base, no Gridfinity foot.
Inside is a smooth round-bottomed trough instead of a flat floor and square inside
corners.

## Design notes

Length and width are plain mm sliders, not Gridfinity cell counts: the tray has no
Gridfinity base, so there's no grid to snap the footprint to. The default values
(209.5 x 41.5) are simply carried over from an earlier Gridfinity-sized version, not
meaningful on their own now — change them freely.

The outside corner rounding (`outer_round`) and the inside floor rounding
(`inside_round`) are sized independently of each other: the inside cavity's own plan
corner is sized off `inside_round` directly, not derived from `outer_round` minus the
wall. That decoupling is deliberate (see Don't) — it's what keeps a generous round
trough from colliding with a tight outer corner.

The inside wall meets the inside floor on a continuous curve (`inside_round`, 4mm by
default) rather than a square corner, which is what makes it read as a trough rather
than a boxy tray.

## Don't

- Don't bring back a Gridfinity base here without re-reading how the previous one
  broke: splitting the foot into one square per cell is fine on its own, but polishing
  the thin ledge exposed between adjacent feet silently bulged the whole part outward
  on one axis (caught by comparing the built size against the expected one, not by any
  check finding). If a Gridfinity foot comes back, exclude that seam from the polish
  pass from the start.

## Changelog

- 2026-10-20: rounded the four outside corners (`outer_round`), sized independently
  of the inside floor rounding.
- 2026-10-20: removed the Gridfinity base entirely and switched back to plain
  length/width sliders in millimetres.
- 2026-10-07: split the base foot into one 41.5mm square per cell at the standard
  42mm pitch, instead of one foot running the whole length.
- 2026-10-06: switched sizing from free-mm length/width to Gridfinity cell counts,
  default 5 cells wide by 1 deep (209.5 x 41.5mm).
- 2026-10-06: squared the ends and added the standard Gridfinity base foot
  (`gridfinity_base`, on by default).
- 2026-10-06: built as an oblong, round-bottomed tray (150 x 40 x 20mm) per request.
